description: List functions, procedures, and aggregates in a schema. Returns name, arguments, return type, kind (function/procedure/aggregate/window), and implementation language.
name: pg_list_functions

arguments.description: Reconstructed argument list; empty string for a zero-argument routine.

kind.description: function | procedure | aggregate | window, or the raw prokind.

return_type.description: Null for procedures, which have no return type.

title: List functions and procedures
